subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for your recent job application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We appreciate your interest in joining our team. We have received your application and will review it carefully. We will be in touch with you within the next two weeks to update you on the status of your application. If you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reach out. Best regards, [Company Name]
